# Ecqqo

> Ecqqo is an AI executive assistant that lives in WhatsApp. It works across Gmail, Google Calendar and Outlook (mail and calendar).

## What Ecqqo does

- Answers questions about your inbox, calendar and messages ("What needs me today?").
- Books meetings: finds free slots and sends invites.
- Drafts and sends emails when you ask.
- Understands voice notes and photos.
- Sends reminders at the time you ask, in your time zone.
- Urgent-message alerts: watches your WhatsApp conversations and pings you only when something important comes in, with adjustable sensitivity.
- Daily or weekly PDF briefings with decisions, risks and follow-ups.
- Settings, bug reports and feedback by message.

Ecqqo does not auto-reply to your contacts. It alerts you and acts when you ask.

## Getting started

1. Message Ecqqo on WhatsApp at +1 281-944-5450: https://wa.me/12819445450?text=Hi%20Ecqqo
2. Ecqqo replies with a secure setup link.
3. Pick a plan, connect your WhatsApp, email and calendar, and set preferences.

There is no free trial.

## Pricing (USD, monthly)

- Solo, $20/month: all features, 1 connected email & calendar account, $4 of assistant usage included monthly.
- Delegate, $100/month: everything in Solo, plus delegating tasks to your human assistant (with their own workspace), a web command center with full history and activity, custom standing instructions for reports, alerts and chat style, 10 connected email & calendar accounts, and $20 of assistant usage included monthly.

Usage beyond the included credit is billed at cost on the next invoice. An optional usage limit can be turned on in settings. Cancel anytime from the billing portal.
